describe.description: The creature is a large, powerfully built quadrupedal mammal resembling a big cat, shown in side view standing on a flat light surface and turned to face slightly toward the viewer. Its body is long and muscular with a tawny golden-brown coat that is paler cream on the chest, underbelly and chin, and bears faint to moderate dark striping. It has a broad feline head with a short muzzle, a shaggy ruff of longer fur around the neck and chest, four thick legs ending in large paws, and a short thin tail with a dark tip extending from the rear. The overall impression is of a lion-like head and build combined with tiger-like striping.

describe.description: A large, powerfully built four-legged felid shown in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. It has a tawny golden-brown coat that is pale cream-white on the muzzle, chin, chest and belly, with faint dark striping on the torso and forehead and bolder dark striping on the lower legs and tail. The head is broad and lion-like with rounded ears, the neck and chest are deep with slightly longer ruffed fur, the body is long and muscular, and it stands on four sturdy legs ending in large paws, with a short slender tail tipped dark extending behind.
